% E2E canonical fixture — text-mode \halign interline glue.
% Pins the §807 fin_align inter-row \baselineskip interline glue: a
% multi-row text \halign must space its row baselines by \baselineskip, matching
% MiKTeX within the tolerance (+/-0.5pt V / +/-0.1pt H).  This is the
% pure-text leg of the interline-glue fix — no math, no \vcenter, no delimiter
% growth — so the row baselines are the only thing under test.
\hsize=6.5in
\vsize=8.9in
\nopagenumbers
\normalbaselines
\halign{#\hfil&\quad#\hfil\cr
  one&two\cr
  three&four\cr
  five&six\cr}
\bye
